title: kbmon --split passes a relative --store or --key-file unchanged into a pane that starts in the clone's root
goal: kbmon.py --split makes --store and --key-file absolute against the caller's working directory before it builds the pane's command, so the live view reads the files the caller named

run: import os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile;t=tempfile.mkdtemp();r=os.getcwd();p=s.run([sys.executable,os.path.join(r,'_tools/kbmon.py'),'--split','--dry-run','--store','rel/store','--key-file','k.txt'],cwd=t,capture_output=True,text=True,env=dict({k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if k not in ('TMUX','WT_SESSION')},WEZTERM_PANE='3'));o=p.stdout;print(o);sys.exit(1 if (p.returncode!=0 or 'split-pane' not in o or ' rel/store' in o or ' k.txt' in o) else 0)
